title: 3Sum
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return all **unique** triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` with distinct indices `i`, `j`, `k` such that the three values add up to `0`.

The result must not contain duplicate triplets. The order of the triplets, and of the numbers inside each triplet, does not matter.
hints: Sort the array, fix the first number, then use two pointers for the rest.
Skip repeated values for the first number and for the pointers so triplets are not duplicated.
